steps.title: Train att and def to 75 …
steps.text: Train att and def to 75 to unlock Dihns bulwark for speccing at kalph, dags, ankou in catacombs
steps.note: Nightmare Zone; note Ancient Magicks on Defensive or chinning maniacal monkeys on Long-range give more Defence XP/hr than melee.

steps.title: Get 80 attack if you can …
steps.text: Get 80 attack if you can afford a Ghrazi Rapier
steps.note: Nightmare Zone for fastest solo Attack XP; Dharok's set becomes optimal at 92+ Hitpoints, else Blood Moon / Obsidian.

steps.title: Bludgeon is slightly better for kalphite …
steps.text: Bludgeon is slightly better for kalphite and trolls but using whip + fremennik shield is probably better for afking trolls

steps.text: Use glory tele to al kharid or redirection scroll on house tab to Pollnivneach
